title: 大加那利望遠鏡
summary: 以「分段光學與焦面儀器的坐標對接」展開10單元、40步，包含機制、合成算例、獨立驗證和「鏡面坐標直接當作探測器像素坐標」的診斷。
summaryEn: Ten units and forty steps on Segmented optics and focal-instrument coordinates, with mechanisms, synthetic calculations, independent checks and diagnosis of Mirror coordinates treated as detector pixels.
scope: 五個案例脈絡模型單元加五個明示共通量測方法單元；41類技術方法會重用，395個案例各有獨立焦點與失效情境。數值全部為合成教學假設，來源支持公開原理和方法，不宣稱已查明每個設施的內部規格、完工狀態或現場操作流程。醫療內容僅限數位/惰性台架，不含診療、病人參數或設備操作。
scopeEn: Five case-context model units plus five explicitly shared measurement-method units. Methods recur across 41 technical families, while 395 cases have individual focuses and failure scenarios. All numbers are synthetic teaching assumptions. Sources support public principles/methods, not every facility’s internal specifications, completion status or operations. Biomedical work uses digital/inert benches only, with no treatment, patient settings or device operation.

steps.title: 單元1｜繞射角尺度：機制與界面
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Diffraction angular scale: Mechanism and interfaces
steps.objective: 以「分段光學與焦面儀器的坐標對接」完成機制與界面並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete mechanism and interfaces for Segmented optics and focal-instrument coordinates with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課焦點「分段光學與焦面儀器的坐標對接」。畫出「入射波前 → 主鏡 → 支撐與校正 → 焦平面 → 星點或標尺」並圈出與「繞射角尺度」有關的介面。將 1.22*wavelength/aperture 每個變數標到圖上，寫明單位、方向及資料來源。解釋：理想圓孔的第一暗環角尺度約為1.22倍波長除口徑。 再指出這個局部模型無法回答的項目：不是含像差、抖動、大氣與像素取樣的整機解析度。
steps.instructionEn: The case focus is Segmented optics and focal-instrument coordinates. Draw Incoming wavefront → Primary mirror → Support and correction → Focal plane → Point source or scale and mark the interfaces relevant to Diffraction angular scale. Place every variable of 1.22*wavelength/aperture on the drawing with units, direction and provenance. Explain: For an ideal circular aperture, the first dark-ring angle is about 1.22 wavelength divided by aperture. Identify what it cannot establish: This is not system resolution including aberrations, jitter, atmosphere and pixel sampling.
steps.observation: 對照「分段光學與焦面儀器的坐標對接」，輸入變數與量測結果不同：先定義可觀察量，再決定能否使用這個式子。前五單元把共通物理模型套入本課案例；這是局部子系統估算，不是整座設施模型。
steps.observationEn: For Segmented optics and focal-instrument coordinates, distinguish inputs from observed outcomes before deciding whether this equation applies. A shared physical model is applied to the case subsystem, not a complete facility model.
steps.failure: 鏡面坐標直接當作探測器像素坐標；不是含像差、抖動、大氣與像素取樣的整機解析度。
steps.failureEn: Mirror coordinates treated as detector pixels; This is not system resolution including aberrations, jitter, atmosphere and pixel sampling.
steps.check: 提交標註介面圖及變數表；每個變數有單位與假設/來源/量測標籤，並明列「不是含像差、抖動、大氣與像素取樣的整機解析度。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit the interface diagram and variable table with units and assumed/sourced/measured labels, explicitly recording: This is not system resolution including aberrations, jitter, atmosphere and pixel sampling.

steps.title: 單元1｜繞射角尺度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Diffraction angular scale: Quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以「分段光學與焦面儀器的坐標對接」完成定量估算並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete quantitative estimate for Segmented optics and focal-instrument coordinates with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課焦點「分段光學與焦面儀器的坐標對接」的「繞射角尺度」採以下合成教學值：wavelength=5e-07 m；aperture=0.1 m。先逐項檢查量綱，再代入 1.22*wavelength/aperture；獨立基準為 6.1e-06 rad。把 wavelength 增加10%，其他輸入保持原值；先預測方向再重算，結果應為 6.71e-06 rad。將數值、單位與是否可外推分欄記錄。
steps.instructionEn: For Segmented optics and focal-instrument coordinates, use synthetic inputs for Diffraction angular scale: wavelength=5e-07 m；aperture=0.1 m. Check dimensions before evaluating 1.22*wavelength/aperture; the independent benchmark is 6.1e-06 rad. Increase wavelength by 10% with other inputs fixed. Predict direction, then recompute to obtain 6.71e-06 rad. Record value, unit and limits separately.
steps.observation: wavelength增加10%後，結果增加；變化量為 6.1e-07 rad。不是含像差、抖動、大氣與像素取樣的整機解析度。
steps.observationEn: After the 10% input change the result should increase, changing by 6.1e-07 rad. This is not system resolution including aberrations, jitter, atmosphere and pixel sampling.
steps.failure: 鏡面坐標直接當作探測器像素坐標；不是含像差、抖動、大氣與像素取樣的整機解析度。
steps.failureEn: Mirror coordinates treated as detector pixels; This is not system resolution including aberrations, jitter, atmosphere and pixel sampling.
steps.check: 原值重算與 6.1e-06 rad 相符；10%案例與 6.71e-06 相符（算術相對容差1e-8）。這個容差只驗算術，不是設備驗收標準。
steps.checkEn: Match 6.1e-06 rad at baseline and 6.71e-06 after variation within relative arithmetic tolerance 1e-8. This checks arithmetic, not equipment acceptance.

quiz.question: 合成基準的正確結果是哪個（rad）？
quiz.explanation: 按 1.22*wavelength/aperture 逐項代入，結果為 6.1e-06；輸入全部為教學假設。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting into 1.22*wavelength/aperture gives 6.1e-06; all inputs are teaching assumptions.

steps.title: 單元1｜繞射角尺度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Diffraction angular scale: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「分段光學與焦面儀器的坐標對接」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for Segmented optics and focal-instrument coordinates with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「分段光學與焦面儀器的坐標對接」設計「繞射角尺度」的獨立驗證：在合成點像比較兩口徑，另列感測器像素與抖動造成的展寬。 用合成點源、波前和位置資料，分離繞射、像差、取樣及重力/熱變形。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For Segmented optics and focal-instrument coordinates, independently verify Diffraction angular scale: Compare synthetic point images at two apertures and separate pixel and jitter broadening. Use synthetic point sources, wavefronts and positions to separate diffraction, aberration, sampling and deformation. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「鏡面坐標直接當作探測器像素坐標」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate Mirror coordinates treated as detector pixels rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 鏡面坐標直接當作探測器像素坐標；不是含像差、抖動、大氣與像素取樣的整機解析度。
steps.failureEn: Mirror coordinates treated as detector pixels; This is not system resolution including aberrations, jitter, atmosphere and pixel sampling.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「不是含像差、抖動、大氣與像素取樣的整機解析度。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state This is not system resolution including aberrations, jitter, atmosphere and pixel sampling.

quiz.question: 哪一份驗證紀錄可供他人重做？
options: 保留原始資料並執行：在合成點像比較兩口徑，另列感測器像素與抖動造成的展寬。
只保留最後的通過字樣。
把無效輸入刪掉後稱全部通過。
optionsEn: Retain raw data and perform: Compare synthetic point images at two apertures and separate pixel and jitter broadening.
Retain only a PASS label.
Delete invalid inputs and claim all cases passed.

steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Diffraction angular scale: Diagnosis and deliverable

Deliver the diagram, baseline/sensitivity calculations, A/B/C tests and remaining evidence gaps.

steps.title: 單元2｜像素取樣尺度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 2 | Pixel sampling scale: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「分段光學與焦面儀器的坐標對接」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for Segmented optics and focal-instrument coordinates with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「分段光學與焦面儀器的坐標對接」設計「像素取樣尺度」的獨立驗證：以合成標尺在中心與四角量比例，檢查畸變是否改變像素尺度。 用合成點源、波前和位置資料，分離繞射、像差、取樣及重力/熱變形。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For Segmented optics and focal-instrument coordinates, independently verify Pixel sampling scale: Measure a synthetic scale at centre and corners to check distortion-dependent scale. Use synthetic point sources, wavefronts and positions to separate diffraction, aberration, sampling and deformation. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「鏡面坐標直接當作探測器像素坐標」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate Mirror coordinates treated as detector pixels rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 鏡面坐標直接當作探測器像素坐標；需另考慮點擴散、對比、畸變和取樣定理。
steps.failureEn: Mirror coordinates treated as detector pixels; Point spread, contrast, distortion and sampling theory remain relevant.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「需另考慮點擴散、對比、畸變和取樣定理。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state Point spread, contrast, distortion and sampling theory remain relevant.

quiz.question: 哪一份驗證紀錄可供他人重做？
options: 只保留最後的通過字樣。
把無效輸入刪掉後稱全部通過。
保留原始資料並執行：以合成標尺在中心與四角量比例，檢查畸變是否改變像素尺度。
optionsEn: Retain only a PASS label.
Delete invalid inputs and claim all cases passed.
Retain raw data and perform: Measure a synthetic scale at centre and corners to check distortion-dependent scale.
quiz.explanation: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「需另考慮點擴散、對比、畸變和取樣定理。」。

steps.title: 單元2｜像素取樣尺度：失效診斷與交付
steps.titleEn: Unit 2 | Pixel sampling scale: Diagnosis and deliverable
steps.objective: 以「分段光學與焦面儀器的坐標對接」完成失效診斷與交付並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete diagnosis and deliverable for Segmented optics and focal-instrument coordinates with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課失效情境是「鏡面坐標直接當作探測器像素坐標」。以本單元「像素取樣尺度」的變數表建立兩個競爭解釋：真實工程量改變，以及感測/單位/邊界錯誤。選用「以合成標尺在中心與四角量比例，檢查畸變是否改變像素尺度。」作區分證據；記錄哪個觀測會推翻各解釋。最後交付介面圖、基準與敏感度計算、A/B/C測試，以及仍缺的證據。
steps.instructionEn: The case failure is Mirror coordinates treated as detector pixels. For Pixel sampling scale, compare a real engineering change with a sensing/unit/boundary error. Use Measure a synthetic scale at centre and corners to check distortion-dependent scale. to discriminate and state an observation that would refute each explanation. Deliver the diagram, baseline/sensitivity calculations, A/B/C tests and remaining evidence gaps.
steps.observation: 「鏡面坐標直接當作探測器像素坐標」不是單靠 0.02 mm/pixel 就能排除；需要對應量測與適用邊界。
steps.observationEn: The number 0.02 mm/pixel alone cannot exclude Mirror coordinates treated as detector pixels; matched measurements and applicability boundaries are needed.
steps.failure: 鏡面坐標直接當作探測器像素坐標；需另考慮點擴散、對比、畸變和取樣定理。

steps.check: 交付單元2的五項證據包；清楚寫出「分段光學與焦面儀器的坐標對接」中此模型可解釋與不可解釋的部分，並保留失敗案例。
steps.checkEn: Deliver the five-item evidence pack for unit 2, stating what the model can/cannot explain for Segmented optics and focal-instrument coordinates and retaining failed cases.
